brief_summary: Three-milestone horizontal timeline: solid amber marker at the original 2017-04-01 dye-sub PBT release, a dashed undated marker noting that later Drop MT3 runs moved to double-shot ABS, and a solid amber marker at the 2026-08-24 catalog restock to in-stock status.
